option.name: -log-rotate-max-files

option.name: -field
tip: Print only the field with the given name. Useful for piping to other processes.

tip: Allow the write operation to continue with no key=value pairs.

global_option.name: -address
tip: Address of the Vault server. The default is https://127.0.0.1:8200. Can also be specified via the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.

global_option.name: -agent-address
tip: Address of the Agent. Can also be specified via the VAULT_AGENT_ADDR environment variable.

global_option.name: -ca-cert
tip: Path to a single PEM-encoded CA certificate to verify the Vault server's SSL certificate. Takes precedence over -ca-path.

global_option.name: -ca-path
tip: Path to a directory of PEM-encoded CA certificates to verify the Vault server's SSL certificate.

global_option.name: -client-cert
tip: Path to a PEM-encoded client certificate to use for TLS authentication to the Vault server. Requires -client-key.

global_option.name: -client-key
tip: Path to a PEM-encoded private key matching the client certificate from -client-cert.

global_option.name: -disable-redirects
tip: Disable the default client behavior, which honors a single redirect response from a request.

global_option.name: -format
tip: Print the output in the given format. Valid formats are table, json, yaml, or pretty. raw is allowed for vault read operations only.

global_option.name: -header
tip: Key-value pair to add as an HTTP header to any request done by the CLI. Headers starting with X-Vault- are forbidden. Can be specified multiple times.

global_option.name: -mfa
tip: Supply MFA credentials as part of the X-Vault-MFA header.

global_option.name: -namespace
tip: The namespace to use for the command. -ns can be used as a shortcut.

global_option.name: -non-interactive
tip: When set true, prevents asking the user for input via the terminal.

global_option.name: -output-curl-string
tip: Instead of executing the request, print an equivalent cURL command string and exit.

global_option.name: -output-policy
tip: Instead of executing the request, print an example HCL policy that would be required to run this command, and exit.

global_option.name: -policy-override
tip: Override a Sentinel policy that has a soft-mandatory enforcement level specified.

global_option.name: -tls-server-name
tip: Name to use as the SNI host when connecting to the Vault server via TLS.

global_option.name: -tls-skip-verify
tip: Disable verification of TLS certificates. Highly discouraged as it decreases security.

global_option.name: -unlock-key
tip: Key to unlock a namespace API lock.

global_option.name: -wrap-ttl
tip: Wraps the response in a cubbyhole token with the requested TTL. The response is available via the vault unwrap command.
